text: P176619 - Jordan Water Sector Efficiency Project: 85 public records (as of 2026-11-23). By group, with the latest in each by document date:

Design (program/project information documents, concept ESRS, PAD): latest is the PAD, PAD5170, 2023-05-24 (disclosed 2023-06-15), http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099052623124518529. Earlier: concept PID (2022-07-28, when the operation was still called a Program-for-Results), appraisal PID (2023-05-15, Arabic version 2023-06-14).

Legal (loan agreement, disbursement letters, corrigendum): latest is the Disbursement and Financial Information Letter for the AFD co-financing loan C2580-JO, dated 2025-06-27 (disclosed 2026-02-02). The Loan Agreement for Loan 9560-JO and Trust Fund TF0C1892 is dated 2023-07-16, http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099071723083513920; a corrigendum letter followed on 2023-12-11.

Environmental and social (ESCP, SEP, ESMF, resettlement framework, labor management procedures, ESIA, ESMP): latest record is an Environmental and Social Management Plan, 2024-08-14; the latest ESCP is the negotiation version of 2023-05-22 (an earlier ESCP is dated 2023-05-16).

Implementation (ISRs, procurement plans, audit): latest ISR is sequence 8, ISR07766, 2026-06-15, http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099061526090548083; latest procurement plan 2026-10-13 (about 50 plans in all); latest audit 2026-07-30.
Restructuring: one Disclosable Restructuring Paper, RES01493, 2026-03-27, http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099032726042556066.
Grouping is by WDS document type; ISRs disclosed in several copies (e.g. three of 2025-04-03) are counted once.

right_sources: Retrieves the project's whole document list and identifies the latest record in each group by document date.
grounded: Every document named exists with the stated type and date; no invented documents.
complete: Covers all five groups (plus completion or 'none'), with the latest document's title, date and link in each.
scoped: Says the list is the publicly disclosed documents and notes there are no completion documents yet.

notes: Active project: new ISRs and procurement plans are disclosed regularly; a later run should accept newer latest documents.
